items.summary: Maintain a three-site preview-only pipeline: complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. Each requires a site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics and affiliate readiness boundary, compliance checklist, security disposition, accountable owner, rollback point, and launch gate. No domains, spending, deployment, monetization changes, or public launch are authorized. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, so no new implementation admission is requested.

Strongest candidate: complicated.work, based on the validated site-factory build score of 84 and existing scaffold. Exactly one next step: CTO records the dated readiness-gate disposition for complicated.work, including accountable owner, preview/build evidence, content and SEO seed, analytics/affiliate measurement boundary, legal/compliance status, security status, rollback point, and explicit blockers. Do not build, deploy, publish, add domains, spend, or configure telemetry until the readiness artifact is complete and capacity is released.
